latest_release.name: OpenIDEA v0.1.44
latest_release.body:
OpenIDEA 0.1.44 adds relative line numbers, pinned and grouped agent tasks, agent commands in Run tool window tabs over MCP, Snowflake data sources, pom.xml dependency completion, Open on GitHub / GitLab from Open In, Prisma, header completion and DTO request bodies in the HTTP Client, in-place updates of portable Windows installs, and ships Plugin API 1.7.

### Download

|---|---|---|---|
| x86-64 (64-bit) | [EXE](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_x64-setup.exe)   [MSI](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_x64_en-US.msi)   [Portable](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_windows_x64_portable.zip) | [Intel](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_x64.dmg) | [AppImage](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_amd64.AppImage)   [DEB](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_amd64.deb)   [RPM](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA-0.1.44-1.x86_64.rpm) |
| AArch64 (ARM64) | [EXE](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_arm64-setup.exe)   [MSI](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_arm64_en-US.msi)   [Portable](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_windows_arm64_portable.zip) | [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_aarch64.dmg) | [AppImage](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_aarch64.AppImage)   [DEB](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA_0.1.44_arm64.deb)   [RPM](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/OpenIDEA-0.1.44-1.aarch64.rpm) |

**Remote development:** `openidea-server` for [Linux x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/openidea-server-linux-x86_64.gz) · [Linux ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/openidea-server-linux-aarch64.gz) · [macOS x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/openidea-server-macos-x86_64.gz) · [macOS ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.44/openidea-server-macos-aarch64.gz), each with a `.sha256` file.

**Already installed?** OpenIDEA updates itself: use **Check for Updates**.

## What's new

### Editor and languages
- **Relative and hybrid line numbers**; rendered documentation comments; the date of the last change in the code vision author hint.
- **Fix ESLint Problems**, and fix-all on save runs for every language server that offers it.
- Maven: complete `groupId`, `artifactId` and version of `pom.xml` dependencies; go from a dependency, plugin or parent to its own POM; import external Maven modules from Project Structure.
- Java uses of Kotlin classes open the `.kt` source; JAR Applications run on the project JDK; builds fall back to Maven when JDT's annotation processing recreates a file (MapStruct-Plus).
- Vue: go to `this.$refs` targets and their components' members; `@/` imports resolve in projects without Vue CLI (Vue CLI 2, webpack, Vite).
- Python: manage every interpreter from one settings page; virtual environments are excluded from source roots whatever their name.
- **Prisma** support; Go files get a gopher icon.

### AI agents and MCP
- **Pin tasks and arrange them in groups**; a task's project, checkout and branch as chips; the context window's size in the usage meter; review a task's commits in the Changes pane.
- Choose whether new tasks start asking for approval; permissions are judged by request kind and command, only commands every shell reads alike are auto-approved, and agents' environment values live in the credential store.
- MCP: agent commands run

detail.readme:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

English · 简体中文

Download  ·  Docs  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. IDEA analyses Python more deeply, so "ready" doesn't mean the same work on both sides. Both are measured from the outside, the same way: see [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) to run it on your machine and projects. ## Plugins Plugins add actions, completion, quick fixes, tool windows, custom editors, themes, file icons and languages. They run as sandboxed WebAssembly components; themes, icon themes and languages need no code at all. Install them from Settings › Plugins, or start your own with `openidea-plugin new` — see [Writing OpenIDEA plugins](https://openidea.sh/en/plugins) and the [official plugins](plugins/official). The plugin API is still a preview. ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP) — questions, feedback and release news. - WeChat group — scan to join: - Contributing: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [contributor docs](https://openidea.sh/en/contribute/setup). ## License [Apache 2.0](LICENSE). Bundled third-party assets are listed in [`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). Not affiliated with JetBrains. IntelliJ IDEA is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.
detail.readme_zh:
你熟悉的 IDE，用 Rust 重新打造。

English · 简体中文

下载  ·  文档  ·  性能对比  ·  插件  ·  社区  ·  赞助

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA 把 IntelliJ IDEA 的使用方式（快捷键、工具窗口、随处搜索的习惯）带到一个以 Rust 为核心的原生桌面应用里。 编辑器、代码洞察、调试器、Git、终端、数据库客户端和 HTTP 客户端，支持 60 多种语言。 提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 版本。 ## 性能对比 在缓存已预热的情况下打开 [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade)（Python，约 770 个文件）， 取 5 次运行的中位数： | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------- | | 显示项目窗口 | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | 就绪（CPU 平稳） | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | 内存（USS，所有进程） | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | 就绪前消耗的 CPU 时间 | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | 空闲 CPU | 单核的 **4 %** | 单核的 7 % | | 退出 | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | 测试使用 `main` 分支的 OpenIDEA release 构建，以及默认设置和插件的 IDEA，环境为 Windows 11、 32 核 AMD、62 GB 内存。IDEA 对 Python 的分析更深入，所以两边的“就绪”并不代表完成了同样多的工作。 两者都以相同方式从外部测量：可以用 [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) 在自己的机器和项目上复现。 ## 插件 插件可以添加操作、补全、快速修复、工具窗口、自定义编辑器、主题、文件图标和语言。插件以沙箱化的 WebAssembly 组件运行；主题、图标主题和语言无需编写代码。 在“设置 › 插件”中安装，或用 `openidea-plugin new` 创建自己的插件：参见 [编写 OpenIDEA 插件](https://openidea.sh/zh/plugins)和[官方插件](plugins/official)。插件 API 目前仍是预览版。 ## 社区 - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP)：提问、反馈和版本发布消息。 - 微信群，扫码加入： - 参与贡献：参见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和[贡献者文档](https://openidea.sh/zh/contribute/setup)。 ## 赞助 如果 OpenIDEA 帮你节省了时间，可以通过支付宝或微信支付支持它的开发。
